name: New Hokage Servant: Naruto Parody Game
source: You play as Yu Kagami, the Hokage's servant. You've just become a servant to Lady Tsunade, the Fifth Hokage - the person who saved you three years ago. As you're working, something strange begins to happen in the village...
translation: 你扮演火影的仆人加贺美优。你刚刚成为了三年前救了你的第五代火影纲手夫人的仆人。当你工作时，村里开始发生一些奇怪的事情……
